part.text:
Now I have all the information needed. Let me execute the SQL query to find schools meeting both criteria:
- Percent eligible for free meals (K-12) > 0.1
- Test takers with SAT score >= 1500 (NumGE1500 > 0)

input.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT f.`School Name` 
FROM frpm f 
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds 
WHERE (f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) > 0.1
